Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Passagierliste?

In this glossary, Passagierliste refers to: An official list of all passengers onboard an aircraft, required by aviation regulations for tracking, safety, and emergency response.

How is Passagierliste used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Bitte stellen Sie sicher, dass die Passagierliste vollständig ist und vor dem Abflug an die ATC übermittelt wurde."

Why does Passagierliste matter in aviation?

Passagierliste matters because it supports clear communication in Cabin contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses Passagierliste?

Passagierliste is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

What category does Passagierliste belong to?

Where does this definition come from?
